new_jobs.title: Senior HR Operation Manager - APAC
new_jobs.jd: At NVIDIA, our people are our greatest strength. As we continue to experience rapid growth, we are looking for a leader to manage our HR Operations team for APAC region. In this role, you will own the APAC HR operations roadmap—balancing scale, speed, service quality, and local compliance across a highly complex region. You will partner seamlessly with cross-functional global teams to elevate service delivery, simplify workflows, and translate regional complexity into flawless execution. This is an outstanding opportunity for a thoughtful, transformational leader who can build strong teams, raise the bar on operational rigor, and deliver an exceptional employee experience from hire to retire. **What You’ll Be Doing** * Own the APAC HR Operations roadmap. Lead, coach, and inspire a distributed team, building a culture of accountability, inclusion, and continuous enhancement. * Drive a frictionless, high-quality employee lifecycle by building a regional operating model that balances standardized global processes with localized country requirements. * Partner with global HR Operations leaders to align regional practices with enterprise standards, while fiercely representing APAC needs and ensuring seamless handoffs with Recruiting, Payroll, and Mobility. * Establish and monitor rigorous service level metrics and operational health indicators. Identify automation and digitization opportunities that aggressively reduce manual work and improve speed, accuracy, and transparency. * Strengthen data quality, process controls, and audit readiness, ensuring strict policy adherence and risk mitigation across all APAC HR processes. **What We Need To See** * 12+ years of relevant experience in HR operations, HR shared services, or people operations, preferably within a fast-paced, multi-country environment. * 5+ years of experience managing and developing sizable teams. * Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Operations, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * Proven success leading and developing teams across diverse APAC markets, navigating local regulatory, cultural, and operational complexities. * Strong experience using data, metrics, and service insights to drive cross-functional process improvement, simplification, and operational change at scale. * Excellent judgment and communication skills, with a proven ability to influence and build trust with business partners and global HR leaders. **Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd** * Experience leading and scaling APAC HR operations in a hyper-growth global technology company. * A proven track record of building, redesigning, or transforming regional shared services and employee experience models. * Strong technical exposure to Workday and Service Now HR operations, advanced case management, and HR process automation. With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. , , JR2024946

new_jobs.title: Commercial Operations Specialist
new_jobs.jd: **Position Summary** The **Commercial Operation Specialist** will play a key role in building and optimizing STERIS Taiwan’s commercial operations infrastructure. This position will lead and support ERP implementation, manage end-to-end order and inventory processes, and provide operational support to the Sales and Business Development teams. The role will work closely with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Service, and regional STERIS teams to ensure efficient and accurate business operations. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to process improvement, data management, and cross-functional collaboration. This is a key role for STERIS Taiwan, with the opportunity to help establish scalable systems and processes that support the company’s continued growth. **What You Will Do** * Report directly to the Commercial Leader and provide dedicated operational support to the commercial organization, with a strong focus on supporting Sales and Business Development needs. * Lead and support the implementation, configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of STERIS Taiwan’s ERP system, acting as the key local contact with ERP vendors and relevant global teams. * Proactively plan, prioritize, and execute assigned projects and daily operational activities while remaining highly responsive and flexible to evolving business and Sales requirements. * Manage end-to-end commercial operations, including purchasing, sales orders, inventory, shipment, invoicing, and related documentation, ensuring timely and accurate execution. * Support Sales and Business Development teams with quotations, tenders, capital order processing, product launches, sample requests, customer inquiries, and other commercial activities. * Monitor and follow up on purchase orders, sales orders, backorders, shipment schedules, invoicing, and delivery status, proactively identifying and resolving operational issues. * Coordinate closely with STERIS APAC teams, Finance, Supply Chain, overseas factories, logistics providers, distributors, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth product supply and delivery. * Maintain accurate ERP master data, including customer, vendor, product/SKU, pricing, inventory, and other relevant commercial information. * Monitor inventory levels, product availability, and customer delivery expectations, working closely with Sales and Supply Chain teams to support effective inventory planning. * Develop and maintain sales, inventory, order, revenue, gross margin, and other commercial reports and dashboards to support business reviews and decision-making. * Serve as a key bridge between Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Service, Marketing, and other functions, translating commercial requirements into effective operational actions. * Develop, document, implement, and maintain SOPs and standardized commercial processes in alignment with STERIS policies, global standards, and local requirements. * Identify and implement opportunities for process improvement, digitalization, automation, and cost savings to improve commercial efficiency and customer service. * Support ERP and process training for internal users and relevant stakeholders, ensuring effective adoption and consistent use of systems and processes. * Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and projects, proactively identify opportunities and issues, and provide timely and reliable support to the Commercial Leader and Sales team as business needs evolve. **The Experience, Skills And Abilities Needed** * Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline. * Minimum 3 years working experiences in team assistant, office administration or secretarial role in MNC companies. Medical Device Industry is preferred. * Responsible, detailed oriented, independent, mature, well-organized, stable and a good team player. * Proficient at Microsoft office skills * Proficient at ERP systems * Verbal and written communication skills in Mandarin and English to support communication with internal and external stakeholders. This position requires knowledge of English due to the nature of the duties involved, including regular communications outside the province of Quebec, training, email communications, and frequent meetings and interactions with English- only employees. The employer has taken all reasonable steps to avoid imposing this language requirement, in accordance with the Charter of the French Language. STERIS is a leading global provider of products and services that support patient care with an emphasis on infection prevention. WE HELP OUR CUSTOMERS CREATE A HEALTHIER AND SAFER WORLD by providing innovative healthcare and life sciences products and services around the globe. For more information, visit www.steris.com. STERIS strives to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

new_jobs.title: Officer, Cash and Trade Process Analyst, Liquidity Management Services
new_jobs.jd: As a Cash and Trade Process Analyst, you will play a key role in strengthening how Citi's Liquidity Management Services team supports cash, liquidity, and deposit management for corporate clients. This role sits within the Treasury and Trade Solutions business and focuses on identifying process improvements, researching emerging technology capabilities, and partnering with internal stakeholders to deliver more efficient, reliable operations. You will contribute directly to reducing manual effort, improving service quality, and shaping how the team adopts new tools and ways of working. **Responsibilities** * Identify and recommend technology capabilities that reduce manual processing and lower the volume of client inquiries. * Research current trends in treasury operations and cash and liquidity management to propose practical improvements. * Partner with vendors, technology teams, and client operations groups to test and refine new process solutions. * Implement improvements that increase operating efficiency and strengthen the overall client experience. * Support adoption of new tools and processes across the Liquidity Management Services team. * Translate business and operational requirements into clear specifications throughout each project. * Evaluate risk in day-to-day decisions and escalate control issues promptly and transparently. * Collaborate with stakeholders across the region, including colleagues who do not speak Chinese, to align on priorities and solutions. **Required Qualifications & Skills** * 3 to 5 years of experience in bank operations. * Background in cash management, liquidity management, or deposit management for corporate clients. * Practical knowledge of system development lifecycle processes. * Clear verbal and written communication skills for working with internal stakeholders. * Strong analytical skills with the ability to present findings clearly. * Ability to work effectively with non-Chinese speaking colleagues across the region. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * Commitment to passing the Financial Markets and Professional Ethics & Proficiency Test for Bank Internal Control and Audit as a condition of the role. **Beneficial Skills & Qualifications** * Familiarity with emerging technologies relevant to treasury and banking operations. * Experience working on cross-functional projects involving vendors and technology partners. * Passing Basic Proficiency Test for International Banking Personnel **What We Offer** Join a team where your operational expertise directly shapes how Citi delivers cash and liquidity services across the region, while building skills that support long-term career growth. * Work in a hybrid arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely. * Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple markets and functions. * Access structured learning and development opportunities to build your operations and treasury expertise. * Gain exposure to process improvement and technology adoption projects that build transferable skills. * Benefit from programs supporting financial wellbeing, family support, and work-life balance. Apply now to help shape the future of cash and liquidity operations within Citi's Treasury and Trade Solutions team. 作為現金及貿易處理分析師，您將在花旗流動性管理服務團隊中擔任重要角色，協助強化企業客戶的現金、流動性及存款管理服務。此職位隸屬於花旗的財資及貿易解決方案業務，專注於識別流程改善機會、研究新興技術能力，並與內部相關人員合作，以提升營運效率及可靠性。您將直接參與減少人手處理工作、提升服務品質，並協助團隊採用新工具與工作方式。 **職責** * 識別並建議能減少人手處理及降低客戶查詢量的技術能力。 * 研究財資營運以及現金與流動性管理的最新趨勢，提出切實可行的改善建議。 * 與供應商、技術團隊及客戶營運團隊合作，測試並完善新的流程方案。 * 推行能提升營運效率及改善整體客戶體驗的方案。 * 支援流動性管理服務團隊採用新工具及新流程。 * 在整個專案過程中，將業務及營運需求轉化為清晰明確的要求。 * 評估日常決策中的風險，並及時、透明地上報控制問題。 * 與區內相關人員（包括非華語同事）緊密合作，共同確立優先事項及解決方案。 **必備資格與技能** * 擁有3至5年銀行營運經驗。 * 具備企業客戶現金管理、流動性管理或存款管理相關背景。 * 熟悉系統開發生命週期流程的實際運作。 * 具備清晰的口頭及書面溝通能力，能與內部相關人員有效協作。 * 具備良好的分析能力，並能清楚地呈現分析結果。 * 能夠與區內非華語同事有效合作。 * 持有學士學位或具備同等實務經驗。 * 通過金融市場常識與職業道德及銀行內部控制與內部稽核測試，作為本職位的任職條件。 **加分資格與技能** * 熟悉與財資及銀行營運相關的新興技術。 * 具備參與涉及供應商及技術夥伴的跨職能專案經驗。 * 通過初階外匯人員專業能力測驗 **我們提供的待遇** 加入我們的團隊，您的營運專長將直接影響花旗在區內提供現金及流動性服務的方式，同時助您建立有利長遠職涯發展的技能。 * 採用混合工作模式，每週3天在辦公室工作，2天遠距工作。 * 與多個市場及職能範疇的同事及相關人員緊密合作。 * 獲得系統化的學習與發展機會，提升您在營運及財資領域的專業能力。 * 參與流程改善及技術應用相關專案，累積可轉移的技能。 * 享有支援財務健康、家庭及工作與生活平衡的相關計劃。 立即申請，協助塑造花旗財資及貿易解決方案團隊未來的現金及流動性營運模式。 ------------------------------------------------------ **Job Family Group:** Operations - new_jobs.title: Product Management Lead, Platforms and Data Services – Vice President - TAIPEI, TAIWAN

This position is part of the Services division, which provides global solutions that help corporations, financial institutions, and public sector clients optimize operations and drive their business forward. We are looking for a client-obsessed product manager to lead the strategic vision and execution of commercialization for the full suite of Digital Platform offerings for our transaction banking clients in Taiwan. The product manager will manage the adoption of Citi’s digital banking capabilities, using our platforms (CitiDirect, CitiConnect), Onboarding, Data, and AI solutions as “building blocks” to solve client business challenges, helping to drive their operational efficiency and business growth. This role requires a blend of deep product management expertise, strong client focus, extensive collaboration, and rigorous financial and risk management. Effective negotiation, advanced communication, and strong interpersonal skills are essential for influencing stakeholders and prioritizing initiatives. What you will do * Oversee the strategic roadmap, development, launch, and marketing for all PDS products to gain maximum benefit and drive adoption across client segments in Taiwan. * Act as the subject matter expert for all PDS products, including CitiDirect, CitiConnect (API, Host-to-Host, ERP Integrators), Onboarding, Data, and AI. * Partner with the sales head, client executives, and coverage teams to execute go-to-market strategies and address client pain points and issues. * Execute client value propositions, positioning, segmentation, and channel strategies to achieve preferred partner status with Citi clients. * Manage day-to-day product responsibilities, including product delivery, client experience, and adherence to in-country regulatory and compliance obligations. * Contribute to the achievement of acquisition targets, product financial performance, revenue goals, and expense management. * Represent Taiwan as the voice of its clients, influencing and delivering product enhancements and managing the innovation roadmap. * Represent Citi in industry working groups to help execute on country-wide digitization agendas. * Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations. What you will get * A high-profile and highly visible role. * Being a product manager of the ever-growing, fast-paced, and strategic digital product space in banking. * Client-facing and industry-leading opportunities. * Experience in building digital products as a market leader. * Growth opportunities within the market and across PDS. Who are we looking for * 6-10 years of relevant experience, preferably in a financial services Product or Platform Management function. * Experience in transaction banking, corporate banking, digital banking, or digital product management is highly desirable. * A problem solver with a roll-up-your-sleeves and can-do attitude. * Proven experience in the successful implementation of large or complex projects while managing cross-functional stakeholders. * A strong communicator, with consistently clear and concise written and verbal skills (fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese language is mandatory). * Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. * Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements. * Ability to work unsupervised and adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate. * Pluses / Nice-to-haves: Knowledge of corporate onboarding; knowledge of connectivity between banks and corporate/FI ERPs/TMS's; experience managing systems/digital solutions/platforms used by corporate clients. new_jobs.title: Finance Technology Lead
new_jobs.jd: **Join Trend ‧ Join New Generation** **趨勢科技 - 全球雲端資安領航者 / 全亞洲最大軟體公司 / 企業版圖橫跨五大洲 / 趨勢全球研發基地在台灣** =============================================================== The Role The Finance Technology Lead will own the technology, data and automation agenda for the Finance organisation. The role will be responsible for defining and delivering the Finance technology strategy, improving the existing Finance technology landscape, and building the roadmap toward a globally integrated, automated and data-driven Finance operating model. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Technology, Data and AI, partnering closely with Finance process owners and the IT organisation. The successful candidate will bring a solid understanding of Finance processes together with hands-on knowledge of AI, automation, agentic workflows, data and reporting solutions. A critical part of the role will be to build, develop and lead a small Finance Technology team with the combined capabilities required across finance systems, ERP, data, automation, AI, product management and transformation delivery. This is not a traditional Finance role. We are looking for someone who can understand how Finance operates and, more importantly, apply technology to transform how Finance work gets done. Key Responsibilities * Finance technology strategy: Define and maintain the target Finance technology architecture and multi-year roadmap across ERP, billing, revenue accounting, close, consolidation, planning, reporting, treasury, tax, data and automation. * Build the FinTech capability: Design, recruit, develop and lead a small multidisciplinary Finance Technology team, ensuring the team collectively possesses the product, systems, data, automation, AI and programme-delivery capabilities required to execute the Finance technology strategy. * Current-state optimisation: Partner with Finance and IT stakeholders to understand the existing Finance systems, interfaces and data landscape and identify practical opportunities to improve performance before major platform transformation begins.. * Automation & AI: Establish and deliver a pipeline of automation opportunities across Finance using workflow, low-code technology, AI and other digital tools to eliminate manual processing, reconciliation and reporting effort. * ERP & platform strategy: Define Finance requirements for the future ERP architecture and lead the Finance side of platform evaluation, design and implementation when appropriate. * Finance product ownership: Establish a product-management approach for Finance applications, with clear roadmaps, ownership, priorities, users, service levels and measurable outcomes. * Data & analytics: Define Finance data architecture and requirements, including common master data, reporting dimensions, data quality, integration and BI/analytics capabilities. * Process enablement: Partner with Finance Process Owners across R2R, Supplier-to-Pay, Revenue-to-Cash, FP&A and other Finance areas to translate target processes into scalable technology solutions. * Systems integration: Work with IT to reduce manual interfaces and establish robust integrations across Finance, commercial systems, marketplaces, HR, banking and other relevant platforms. * Transformation delivery: Lead Finance technology initiatives from concept through business case, design, implementation, testing, adoption and benefits realisation. * Technology governance: Establish standards for Finance technology investment, application rationalisation, prioritisation and solution design. * Vendor and partner management: Evaluate and manage software vendors, implementation partners and specialist providers, using external capacity where it is more efficient than building permanent internal capability. What We Are Looking For The successful candidate will demonstrate strong experience across many – but not necessarily all – of the following: * Finance technology or Finance transformation leadership * Core Finance processes including R2R, P2P, O2C, Consolidation and FP&A * Major ERP platforms such as D365, SAP or Oracle * Finance systems architecture * Data, reporting and analytics * Automation, workflow and AI * Product management * Cross-functional programme delivery * Multinational and multi-entity environments * Subscription/software business models and recurring billing What Success Looks Like Success in this role means moving Finance away from regional, manual, fragmented and repetitive processes and systems toward globally standardised, automated, data-driven and AI-enabled ways of working. =============================================================== *連結智慧 守護世界 --- Connected Intelligence for Securing a Connected World*

We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About The Team** As a Principal Engagement Manager in our practice, you will be the key player on a team that guides customers through the solution delivery and deployment lifecycle by partnering with Workday leadership, consultants, and resource management. You will be the Workday leader ultimately responsible for managing the Customer experience through deployments. **About The Role** The Principal Engagement Manager will be an expert with the Workday Deployment Methodology while managing large to complex global deployments. In this role, they will use their broad expertise to resolve multiple complex issues in creative and effective ways. They will also support executive level expectations by providing internal recommendations to management, based on field experience, as to how to potentially enhance the Workday Deployment Methodology. **About You** Basic Qualifications * 8+ years of managing complex HCM and/or ERP implementations, with a strong focus on Financials/HCM or Payroll * 3+ years deploying Workday, PeopleSoft ,Oracle, SAP, Ultimate Kronos or similar software **Other Qualifications** * Prior experience working for a professional services consulting firm or supporting HCM/ERP implementations within the customer * Previous experience with project management tools (Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, etc.) * Workday experience highly preferred, though not mandatory * Previous experience managing full project lifecycle, including Project P&L ownership is a plus * Strong ability to support HR transformation and organizational change management initiatives within the context of a technology deployment * Previous SaaS sales experience is a plus. **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). new_jobs.jd: **About Agoda** At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. **The Opportunity:** This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, partner growth, and market intelligence. As a Strategic Account Manager, you will operate in a fast-paced and highly competitive environment, balancing short-term commercial performance with long-term partnership growth. in Taiwan. * Support the Area Manager in preparing country reporting, business reviews, and strategic presentations for senior leadership stakeholders. **What you’ll Need to Succeed:** * Minimum 5 new_jobs.title: Product Manager
new_jobs.location: New Taipei City, New Taipei City, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: **Company Description:** ARBOR Technology Corp. is a global provider of intelligent computing platforms and AIoT solutions that help solve real-world problems and drive industrial innovation. Since 1993, ARBOR has delivered continuous advancements across healthcare, logistics, smart retail, intelligent transportation, and industrial automation. The company is committed to creating impactful, environmentally responsible products and systems through cross-disciplinary collaboration from its base in Taipei to offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. ARBOR operates under ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and ISO 14001 certifications, reflecting a strong focus on quality, safety, and sustainability. The team is united by a mission to accelerate the growth of industries and cities with cutting-edge AIoT technologies. * Location: New Taipei City, Taiwan (On-site) * Product Line: COM-HPC, COM Express, Intel & AMD Platforms **Role Overview:** We are seeking a Product Manager to lead our Computer-on-Module (COM) portfolio, including COM-HPC, COM Express, development kits, and embedded software. You will drive product strategy, roadmap planning, market positioning, and lifecycle management while collaborating with global sales, engineering, and marketing teams to grow business opportunities worldwide. **Key Responsibilities** * Define product vision, roadmap, and go-to-market strategies. * Manage the full product lifecycle from concept to end-of-life. * Gather customer and market requirements, translating them into product specifications. * Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities. * Develop product positioning, business cases, and launch plans. * Work cross-functionally with engineering, sales, marketing, and operations teams. * Support global sales teams in expanding market presence and driving revenue growth. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field. * Experience in product management, product marketing, or related roles. * Strong skills in product lifecycle management, roadmap planning, and market analysis. * Familiarity with embedded computing, COM, industrial PCs, AIoT, Edge AI, or industrial automation. * Ability to convert technical concepts into clear product requirements. * Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills. * Fluent in English; additional language skills are a plus. **Preferred** * Experience with Intel/AMD embedded platforms. * Background in B2B technology, embedded systems, or industrial computing. * Experience launching products in global markets. **Join us to shape next-generation embedded computing solutions and drive innovation across AI, industrial, medical, and transportation applications.**
